# Cellulose Insulation Manufacturers Association

> A comprehensive resource for cellulose insulation information, sustainability initiatives, and climate-positive building design.

The Cellulose Insulation Manufacturers Association (CIMA) provides information about cellulose insulation's role in sustainable building practices, energy efficiency, and climate change mitigation. The site covers industry initiatives, environmental benefits, and partnerships with organizations like the American Institute of Architects.

## Key Topics

- Cellulose Insulation
- Energy Efficiency
- Climate Change
- Sustainable Building
- Carbon Emissions
- Green Architecture
- Carbon Sink Homes
- Environmental Benefits
- Carbon Sequestration
- Recycled Content
- Earth Day
- Blueprint For Better
- Green Building
- CIMA

## Sustainability & Climate Impact

- [AIA Blueprint For Better: Design To Change Climate Change](https://cellulose.org/aia-blueprint-for-better-design-to-change-climate-change): AIA Blueprint For Better initiative on climate-positive design using cellulose insulation
- [Why Cellulose Insulation Fits Well With Earth Day](https://cellulose.org/why-cellulose-insulation-fits-well-with-earth-day): Earth Day article highlighting sustainability benefits of cellulose insulation
